Name: ClientDetail
Description: Create or edit one client (SheetAdmin): name, activate/deactivate, read-only list of its projects. ClientId empty = new client.

Name: Clients
Description: Admin list of clients (SheetAdmin): search, show inactive, project count; opens ClientDetail.

Name: Holidays
Description: Admin holiday calendar per year (SheetAdmin): year selector, list with weekday and status, add/edit in a popup, activate/deactivate, copy the fixed-date holidays to the next year.

Name: InvalidPermissions
Description: Screen where users will be redirected when they have invalid permissions.

Name: MySheet
Description: The consultant's timesheet: monthly total, calendar, day status KPIs and weekly project hours, kept in sync. Default screen of the module.

Name: ProjectDetail
Description: Create or edit one project (SheetAdmin): client, code, name, activate/deactivate, and its assigned users (add, edit, end, delete in a popup). ProjectId empty = new project.

Name: Projects
Description: Admin list of projects (SheetAdmin): filter by client, show inactive, assigned users; opens ProjectDetail.

Name: UserDetail
Description: Admin detail of a user (SheetAdmin): ClaudeSheet roles (SheetUser, SheetAdmin, SheetManager) with Save, and the user's project assignments (AssignmentEditor).

Name: Users
Description: Admin list of users (SheetAdmin): search, only users with access, roles as tags, active assignments; opens UserDetail.
